args.title: Remember and restore user's last chosen export format in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Modify the ExportButton component to save the last used export format in local storage or browser storage, and restore this format when the component initializes. This avoids resetting the format menu to CSV every time.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This finding identifies that the ExportButton component currently initializes the export format with a default but does not remember the user's last chosen format. The proposed change is to persist the chosen format in storage and restore it on component load, improving user experience by not reverting to CSV each time.
